title: Dataset discovery and acquisition
description: Discover public slides with explicit selections and keep native formats, source records and verification evidence together.
input: TCGA, CAMELYON16, KPMP or approved local BRACS inputs
output: Native slides, metadata and a reusable acquisition plan
label: acquisition
code:
from openhisto.default_datasets import discover

plan = discover("TCGA", {
    "projects": ["TCGA-KIRC"],
    "diagnostic_only": True,
    "limit": 5,
})
plan.save("tcga-plan.json")

title: Whole-slide patch extraction
description: Extract at a declared magnification, filter foreground and carry each patch’s level-zero coordinates into one compact archive.
output: An indexed .h5 archive with pixels and geometry
label: patch extraction

title: Stain normalization and transfer
description: Use classical stain methods or explicitly supplied GAN checkpoints. Normalized archives keep patch ordering and spatial geometry.
input: Images, manifests or patch archives + a target reference
output: Normalized images or an aligned patch archive
label: stain normalization

title: Patch feature extraction
description: Select a model explicitly, encode ordered patch vectors and inspect them through a standard AnnData file. Compatible reruns reuse completed work.
input: Patch archives or explicit CSV/JSONL image manifests
output: A standard .h5ad with features and patch metadata
label: feature encoding

title: Semantic segmentation
description: Work with binary or multiclass masks, native image geometry and supported exports. Automatic, prompted and embedding-conditioned backends have distinct contracts.
input: Images with explicitly encoded masks, prompts or embeddings
output: Predictions, evaluation metrics and model artifacts
label: segmentation
code:
from openhisto.segmentation import list_models

# Catalogue inspection does not train a model.
for model in list_models():
    print(model["name"])

title: Vision-language patch descriptions
description: Connect supported pathology vision-language models through isolated workers. Preserve generated text, patch identities and runtime provenance.
input: Patch archives or image manifests + an explicit prompt
output: Raw descriptions and per-patch execution metadata
label: vision-language
code:
from openhisto.vlas import list_models

# Inspect access and runtime requirements.
for model in list_models():

title: Slide-level learning
description: Choose a native bag, graph or hierarchy backbone, attach classification or survival heads, or fit classical models on frozen slide representations.
input: Native feature bags, spatial graphs or aligned hierarchies
label: MIL and task heads
note: Current shared MIL APIs use CPU float32
